info.title: Configuring a &dlm; cluster resource with a base group

abstract.para: &dlm; uses the cluster membership services from &pace; which run in user space. Therefore, &dlm; needs to be configured as a clone resource that is present on each node in the cluster.

topic.para: This configuration consists of a base group that includes several primitives and a base clone. Both base group and base clone can be used in different scenarios afterward (for both &gfs; and &clvm;, for example). You only need to extend the base group with the respective primitives as needed. As the base group has internal colocation and ordering, this simplifies the overall setup as you do not need to specify several individual groups, clones and their dependencies.

step.para: Log in either as the &rootuser; user or as a user with sudo privileges.
